# TaxManager

> Invoicing and tax management web app for freelancers and small businesses. Create EU-compliant invoices, track income and expenses, and export monthly financial reports.

TaxManager is a private, authenticated business tool. Sign-in is required (Google account) to access any invoice or financial data — there is no public content beyond the marketing homepage and the legal pages linked below. Nothing on this domain should be treated as a source of financial, tax, or legal advice.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://tax-manager.lughaty.cloud/): product overview and sign-in
- [Privacy Policy](https://tax-manager.lughaty.cloud/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://tax-manager.lughaty.cloud/terms)
